sandbox_running.description: True when the newest session is assigned or active. Always false when the server has no runner store.

session.description: The number of the newest session. 0 when the run has no session or the server has no runner store.

source.description: How the run started. It replaces triggered_by.

source_ref.description: The ID of the automation, schedule, webhook, parent run, scorer or benchmark of the run.

state.description: The core run state in capital letters. The state starting is PENDING. The state idle, which earlier releases stored, is SUCCEEDED.

data.description: Data that depends on the kind, for example the event of a lifecycle message.

ServiceAccount.description: A principal that is not a person, with a role and API keys (prefix ofa_). It has no email and no sign-in.

info.description: REST API of Open Factory. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer of_<prefix>_<secret>`. Roles: user (view and run work) < editor (configure factories, definitions, webhooks, secrets) < admin (delete factories, manage users and integrations). A user can have a role override for one factory; a request about a factory (`x-required-role` on a route with a factory, work item, inbox item, webhook, benchmark run or run in its path) checks the role for that factory. Roles do not decide who can approve a spec or merge a pull request. Lists use cursor pagination (`limit`, `cursor`, `next_cursor`). Errors are RFC 7807 problem documents with a machine-readable `code`.
